title: i'd like to disconnect my iphone

messages.text: i'd like to disconnect my iphone, do you have any plan to use them ?

Yes, you can disconnect it now; no agent needs the iPhone for about the next 2 hours.
- Next phone use: the timing test of the GPU menu box (fix-g0-box), after its Mac and Simulator checks, about 2 h from now. I'll ask you first in a console step.
- The Join waitlist proposal (fix-join-fade, about 30 min) can be tried in any browser; its Try-it phone links work over Wi-Fi, no cable needed.
- I switched off the automatic "plug the cable back in" steps, so you won't get reminders meanwhile.

What you need to do: unplug whenever you like; plug back in only when I ask.
